description: Road Schedule SDCC is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by South Dublin County Council. The road infrastructure is the largest asset managed by local authorities in Ireland. It’s efficient management (both day to day and in the long term) supports economic activity because the majority of commuting and haulage occurs using it. The 31 local authorities operate, maintain and improve the network of regional and local roads. Coverage: South Dublin County Council. The portal files it under the publisher South Dublin County Council. Its tags are Maintenance, RMO, Roads, SDCC, Schedule. It offers 6 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, KML. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
